title: How Long Does a Haircut Take? Every Service, Timed
hero_alt: Divinely Faded's black tufted barber chair, set up for the next appointment
card_text: From a {{minutes:express-facial}} facial to a {{minutes:color-transformation}} color: every service on my menu with the time Booksy holds for it.
lede: A men's haircut at my shop takes {{minutes:essential-haircut}} for the Essential Haircut, {{minutes:signature-cut}} for the Signature Cut and {{minutes:luxury-grooming}} for the Luxury Grooming Experience. Those are the times Booksy holds, and they cover the whole visit, from sitting down to the finished style.
Below is every service on my menu with its length, what fills that time, and how to plan your day around it.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The haircut shaped to your style and head, a straight razor along the neck and a finished style. Nearly all of the time goes into the cut and getting the blend clean.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The same cut plus a beard trim or line-up, a hot towel finish and straight razor detailing. The extra minutes belong to the beard and the towel.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: A consultation first, then the cut, beard sculpt, wash and scalp massage, facial steam, dual hot towels, razor detailing, a basic design, ear and nose waxing, styling and fragrance. A lot fits in, so book it when you aren't in a hurry.

items.title: Straight Razor Beard Shave
items.body: A traditional wet shave: hot towels to soften the beard, shaving cream, the straight razor and an aftershave. The towels are part of the time, not a wait before it.

items.title: Head & Beard Shave
items.body: Head and beard both shaved smooth, with hot towels and an aftershave balm. Two full shaves in one sitting, which makes it the longest shave on the menu.

items.title: Express Facial
items.body: Facial massage, warm steam, a deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation and a hydrating moisturizer. The shortest appointment I have.

items.title: Deluxe Facial
items.body: Massage, steam, exfoliation and moisturizer, plus advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum.

blocks.heading: Braids, perm and color.
blocks.lead: Clear a morning or an afternoon.

items.title: Braids
items.body: Every set is personalized and the price varies with the style. Each row is parted and braided by hand, so the clock follows the number and size of the rows.

items.title: Perm
items.body: Rods, waving solution, neutralizer and a rinse, in that order. A perm can't stop halfway, so the whole block needs to be free.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Bleaching and toning to reach the shade you want. It's the longest appointment on my menu, so plan the rest of the day around it.

blocks.heading: The slot is yours.
paragraphs: The times above are what Booksy reserves, so the slot is yours from start to finish. Thick hair, a big change in length or a detailed fade can use more of it; a cleanup of a cut you already wear uses less.
Add-ons ride along with the booking: a hair design, a wash and scalp massage, eyebrows, nose and ear waxing or a fragrance finish. If you plan to add several, text me so we aren't rushing the end.

blocks.heading: Fit it into your day.
paragraphs: On a lunch break, the Essential or the Signature is the easier fit. Open times show on Booksy, so pick one that leaves room to get back.
Saturday runs 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. For one of the long services on a Saturday, an early start gets you out with the afternoon still yours.
For braids, a perm or a color, eat beforehand and charge your phone. You'll be in the chair a while, and it goes easier when you aren't hungry.
Running late eats into your own slot, because the next appointment starts when it starts. Text me at {{phone}} if you're held up.
Paying takes a minute at the end: cash, card, Zelle or Cash App, after the service.

items.q: How long does a men's haircut take?
items.a: At Divinely Faded, {{minutes:essential-haircut}} for the Essential Haircut, {{minutes:signature-cut}} for the Signature Cut and {{minutes:luxury-grooming}} for the Luxury Grooming Experience.
The Express Facial, at {{minutes:express-facial}}. The quickest haircut is the Essential, at {{minutes:essential-haircut}}.

items.q: How long does a beard shave take?
items.a: The Straight Razor Beard Shave takes {{minutes:straight-razor-beard-shave}}. The Head & Beard Shave, which does both the head and the beard, takes {{minutes:head-beard-shave}}.

items.q: Does a beard trim add time?
items.a: Yes. The Signature Cut, with its beard trim or line-up and hot towel, runs {{minutes:signature-cut}}, against {{minutes:essential-haircut}} for the Essential.

tim_questions: Do add-ons (design, wash, eyebrows, wax, fragrance) add time to the Booksy slot? The post says to text if adding several.
OK to say a cleanup of a cut someone already wears uses less of the slot, and that a late arrival eats into their own time?
